title: Bookshop neighborhood reading wall
brief:
Write a public notice inviting customers at Driftwood Books to contribute to a neighborhood reading wall. From July 1 to July 25, visitors can pick up a blank card at the counter, write the title and author of a book they recommend, and add one short reason. Any genre and reading level are welcome. A first name is optional. Staff will display cards in the shop window through August 15 as space allows. Children may dictate their recommendation to a companion. The notice will stand beside the cards and should tell visitors where to leave completed entries, in the basket by the register.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

**What should the neighborhood read next?**

From July 1 to July 25, help fill the Driftwood Books reading wall with books you love. Pick up a blank card here at the counter. Write the title and author of a book you recommend, then add one short reason a neighbor might enjoy it.

Books of every genre and reading level are welcome. Children may dictate their recommendation to a companion. Add your first name if you like.

Leave your completed card in the basket by the register. Our staff will display cards in the shop window through August 15 as space allows.

# Help Fill Our Neighborhood Reading Wall

What book would you recommend to a neighbor? From July 1 to July 25, pick up a blank card here at the Driftwood Books counter. Write the book’s title and author, then add one short reason you’d recommend it.

Books of every genre and reading level are welcome. You can add your first name if you’d like. Children are welcome to tell a companion what to write on their card.

**Leave your completed card in the basket by the register.** Staff will display recommendations in the shop window through August 15, as space allows. Stop by to see what your neighbors are reading!
